title: MP-Former: Mask-Piloted Transformer for Image Segmentation
mechanism: Feed noised ground-truth masks into Mask2Former's masked attention and train to reconstruct them, making masks consistent across decoder layers and speeding training.
evidence: R: +2.3 AP and +1.6 mIoU on Cityscapes (R50); matches or beats Mask2Former with half the epochs on ADE20K; no inference cost.
adaptation: For M2F on 478 cells: noise model = our known label jitter (1-2 px shifts, dilation of crack masks, random drops of small components); tests whether faster convergence helps with few images.
min_experiment: Only if M2F arm B survives: arm C = + mask-piloted training; baseline M2F arm B; metrics mIoU_rob, inactive IoU at 10k and 20k steps; kill if no gain beyond noise.
prior_overlap: none; unrelated to the offset-tolerant CE that was n.d.

alt_notes.adaptation: Noise model = measured label jitter (1-2 px shifts, source-specific widths); training-efficiency add-on for M2F on 478 images.
alt_notes.min_experiment: M2F arm B vs B + mask-piloted training at 10k and 20k steps; metric mIoU_rob and inactive IoU; kill if no gain > 0.01 mIoU_rob at either length.
